next.reason: 1985: a non-common directly contained program-name 'may be referenced only by statements included in that containing program'. 2023 §2023:8.4.6.3 SR1 keeps that and adds 'or, if the program possesses the recursive attribute, in the program itself'; §2023:11.10.4 GR4: a recursive program 'may call itself'. Looser: a new permitted reference (RECURSIVE did not exist in 1985, so conforming 1985 programs are unaffected).
